The Watson Assistant NLU connector enables integration with [IBM Watson Assistant](https://www.ibm.com/products/watsonx-assistant) to use its language understanding results for powering agents in Cognigy.

## Prerequisites

- Access to IBM Watson Assistant.

## Configuration on the NLU provider side

1. Log in to [IBM Cloud](https://cloud.ibm.com), create a **Watson Assistant** service, and find the **Service URL** under **Credentials**. 
2. In **Watson Assistant**, go to **Skills > Create Skill**, then select a skill type. Note that Action skills aren't supported for API connections.
3. _(Optional)_ In the skill editor, go to **Entities > System Entities** and enable `@sys-date`, `@sys-number`, and `@sys-time`.
4. In **Skills Overview**, click the three dots next to your skill, select **View API Details**, and copy the **API Key** and **Skill ID**.

## Configuration on the Cognigy side

In Cognigy, go to **Advanced > NLU Connectors**, click **Create NLU connector**, select the Watson Assistant connector type, and enter the retrieved credentials.

| Parameter       | Type | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| --------------- | ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **API key**     | Text | An authentication key. Find this key in **Service Credentials** in IBM Cloud under the Watson Assistant service.                                        |
| **Skill ID**    | Text | A unique skill identifier. Find this identifier by clicking the three dots next to the skill in **Skills Overview** and selecting **View API Details**. |
| **Service URL** | Text | An endpoint for accessing the Watson Assistant API. Find this URL in **Service Credentials** under the Watson Assistant service.                        |
